rationale: The fresh pool fixed 36 exact fingerprints with 36 declared archetypes, no duplicate groups, no similarity flags, and no dominant structure. The shortlist preserves eight materially different mechanisms aimed at the sanitized factor gaps: a transactional customs gateway, reimbursement pre-adjudication, an independent AI assurance lab, a contributor-gated clinical-site exchange, insurer-distributed prevention proof, distributor-bundled reagent-lot intelligence, wholesaler-embedded expiry coordination, and reseller-bundled dental acquisition QA. Delayed history was consulted only after deduplication. Nearer repeats in PV diagnostics and warranty recovery, used-battery passports, EEG quality, lab-result normalization, responsible-gambling analytics, EUDR/CBAM evidence ledgers, KSeF release, generic supplier passports, and retrofit evidence were not selected. The selected candidates have distinct payers, paid events, control points, and concentrated distribution routes; their uncommitted channel and data dependencies are assigned for direct adversarial research rather than assumed resolved.
